lines.en: Hannah, look at this pile of packaging. If we had recycled earlier, there would be much less waste in the office today.
lines.pt: Hannah, olhe esta pilha de embalagens. Se tivéssemos reciclado antes, haveria muito menos lixo no escritório hoje.

lines.en: I know. If I had read the memo about separate bins, I would have stopped throwing coffee cups into the paper bin.
lines.pt: Eu sei. Se eu tivesse lido o comunicado sobre as lixeiras separadas, teria parado de jogar copos de café na lixeira de papel.

lines.en: Don’t blame yourself. If the management had explained the system properly, nobody would have made that mistake.
lines.pt: Não se culpe. Se a gerência tivesse explicado o sistema direito, ninguém teria cometido esse erro.

lines.en: True. And if we had asked the supplier for less packaging, we wouldn’t have ended up with all these boxes.
lines.pt: Verdade. E se tivéssemos pedido ao fornecedor menos embalagem, não teríamos ficado com todas essas caixas.

lines.en: Exactly. Last year, the city of Melbourne offered free training. If I had gone, I would have known what to do.
lines.pt: Exato. No ano passado, a cidade de Melbourne ofereceu treinamento gratuito. Se eu tivesse ido, saberia o que fazer.

lines.en: Well, it’s not too late. What would you have done differently if you had been in charge of the project?
lines.pt: Bem, ainda não é tarde. O que você teria feito de diferente se estivesse no comando do projeto?

lines.en: I would have bought refillable containers from the start. We might have saved a lot of money, too.
lines.pt: Eu teria comprado recipientes recarregáveis desde o início. Talvez tivéssemos economizado muito dinheiro também.

lines.en: Good point. I wish someone had measured our rubbish earlier. The numbers would have shocked everybody.
lines.pt: Bom ponto. Eu queria que alguém tivesse medido nosso lixo antes. Os números teriam chocado todo mundo.

lines.en: Let’s propose a plan to the director on Monday. We can show photos and explain what we have learned.
lines.pt: Vamos propor um plano ao diretor na segunda. Podemos mostrar fotos e explicar o que aprendemos.

lines.en: Agreed. If she approves it, we will start a recycling team next week. I’ll write a short summary tonight.
lines.pt: Combinado. Se ela aprovar, vamos começar uma equipe de reciclagem na semana que vem. Escrevo um resumo esta noite.

lines.en: Perfect. If we had started this conversation a year ago, we would have a cleaner office. Better late than never!
lines.pt: Perfeito. Se tivéssemos começado esta conversa há um ano, teríamos um escritório mais limpo. Antes tarde do que nunca!

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: If I had known, I would have helped is a third conditional.
We use if + past simple in the third conditional.
Would have is followed by a past participle.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: If I had known, I would have helped is a third conditional. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We use if + past simple in the third conditional. → Falso (We use if + past perfect.)
Would have is followed by a past participle. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: Waste at the office · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Friday afternoon in Melbourne. Cody and Sara stay late at the office. A pile of boxes blocks the corridor. Empty cups fill the paper bin. Sara sighs and looks at Cody. They decide to talk about the problem.

“Sara, look at this pile of packaging. If we had recycled earlier, there would be much less waste in the office today.” says Cody. “I know. If I had read the memo about separate bins, I would have stopped throwing coffee cups into the paper bin.” says Sara. “Don’t blame yourself. If the management had explained the system properly, nobody would have made that mistake.” says Cody.
